title: Metaphor and Rhetorical Questions
goal: Recognise and use a metaphor, a rhetorical question and repetition.

items: I can recognise and use a metaphor, a rhetorical question and repetition for emphasis.
I can tell a metaphor from a comparison with *como*.
I can choose the one device that suits a sentence.
